findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe YAML deserialization
 * @description Using yaml.load or yaml.unsafe_load with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-yaml-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe YAML deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe YAML deserialization using yaml.load or yaml.unsafe_load functions

message.text: Potentially unsafe YAML deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability
 * @description XML parsing with external entity expansion enabled can lead to file disclosure or SSRF
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe-vulnerability
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // xml.etree.ElementTree.parse, fromstring
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring"]).getACall() or
  // xml.dom.minidom.parse, parseString
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember("minidom").getMember(["parse", "parseString"]).getACall() or
  // xml.sax.parse, parseString
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("sax").getMember(["parse", "parseString"]).getACall() or
  // lxml.etree.parse, fromstring
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring"]).getACall()
select call, "XML parsing without disabling external entity expansion could lead to XXE attacks."
findings.hypothesis: XML parsing without disabling external entity expansion could lead to XXE attacks

message.text: XML parsing without disabling external entity expansion could lead to XXE attacks.
XML parsing without disabling external entity expansion could lead to XXE attacks.
